import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-home', templateUrl: './home.component.html', styleUrls: ['./home.component.css'] }) export class HomeComponent { highlights = [ { title: 'Build-your-own pizza', text: 'Select extra ingredients and see them appear directly on the pizza preview.' }, { title: 'Fake banking checkout', text: 'Customers can place items in the cart and complete a safe demo payment flow.' }, { title: 'Angular requirements covered', text: 'Routing, ngModel, interceptors, services, API calls, and error handling are already wired in.' } ]; }

Order artisan pizza with a live topping preview and a banking checkout.

This front end demonstrates Angular routing, API services, JWT authentication, dynamic pizza customization, cart management, and a demo payment experience.
